d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how a sharp diplomatic rupture in the Horn of Africa saw Somalia order the UAE ambassador to leave within 72 hours and recall its own envoy from Abu Dhabi on November 19, even as Ethiopia welcomed the credentials of the UAE’s new ambassador at the presidential palace on the very same day. Mogadishu accused Abu Dhabi of undermining Somalia’s sovereignty, bypassing federal authority to strike deals with regional administrations over strategic ports including Berbera, Bosaso, and Kismayo, and playing a role in Israel’s recognition of Somaliland—charges…
